fusions.name: Hardened Reeds
fusions.desc: Stiffens the reeds around you into spikes: they deal 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, strip 15% armour for 6 seconds, slow each by 20% and knock each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Cold Tap
fusions.desc: A tapping hop that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed Pores
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and your poison resistance rises by 15%.
